name: Kuwer Industries Limited
about: Kuwer Industries Limited engages in metalizing and embossing polyester and BOPP films business in India. The company offers holographic films and paper, sequin films, metallized paper, window metallized films, and flexible packaging laminates- including printed laminated films, printed laminated papers, such as holographic printed pouches; security holograms, holographic films, flexible packaging material, coated lacquered films; decorative metallized paper; and flexible packaging products, and related activities. Its products have applications in various industries, such as pharmaceuticals, alcohol and beverages, lubricants, food supplements, clothing, cosmetics, financial documents, automobiles, education, tobacco, and entertainment. Kuwer Industries Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Greater Noida, India.
